title: Redas Commitment
description: A structured commitment: one party committing to do something for another party, optionally by a deadline. The Redas Commitment Protocol defines nine canonical fields that participate in the SHA-256 identity hash, plus a handful of metadata fields that are part of the registration payload but do not affect the hash.

description.description: What is being committed to, in free-form prose. Example: 'Install the 480V transformer pad'. HASH FIELD.

owner_name.description: Person making the commitment (the party responsible for delivery). Example: 'Priya Ramesh'. HASH FIELD.

owner_company.description: Company affiliation of the committer. Example: 'Northbridge Construction'. HASH FIELD. Optional — empty string and null are treated identically for hash purposes.

owed_to_name.description: Person the commitment is owed to (the party expecting delivery). Example: 'Alex Morgan'. HASH FIELD.

owed_to_company.description: Company affiliation of the recipient. HASH FIELD. Optional — empty string and null are treated identically for hash purposes.

due_date.description: Deadline as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). HASH FIELD. Null when no deadline is specified.

date_type.description: How the deadline was expressed. 'exact' means a specific date. 'range' means a window. 'asap' means 'as soon as possible'. 'day_of_week' means 'by Friday' without a specific date. 'relative' means 'in two weeks'. HASH FIELD.

category_primary.description: Top-level classification of the commitment. HASH FIELD.

category_secondary.description: Free-form subcategory within the primary category. Example: 'Electrical' within 'Schedule'. HASH FIELD.

confidence.description: How confident the registering party is that the commitment will be delivered. Useful for AI agents registering their own commitments. NOT part of the identity hash — it is metadata, not identity. Default 'MEDIUM' (70) when omitted.

context.description: Free-form context surrounding the commitment — a quote, a meeting excerpt, a reasoning trace. NOT part of the identity hash.

source_reference.description: External identifier from the system that originated the commitment (e.g., Jira ticket ID, meeting recording URL, agent conversation ID). NOT part of the identity hash.

x-hash-canonicalization: alphabetical-key JSON with no whitespace, UTF-8 encoded; missing string fields default to "", missing optional fields default to null
